name: starts with separate elements
code:
uf = UnionFind(4)
assert uf.connected(0, 1) is False
assert uf.connected(2, 3) is False

name: connects elements after union
code:
uf = UnionFind(5)
uf.union(0, 1)
uf.union(1, 2)
assert uf.connected(0, 2) is True
assert uf.connected(0, 4) is False

name: handles repeated unions
code:
uf = UnionFind(3)
uf.union(0, 1)
uf.union(0, 1)
assert uf.connected(0, 1) is True
assert uf.connected(1, 2) is False

name: merges two existing sets
code:
uf = UnionFind(6)
uf.union(0, 1)
uf.union(2, 3)
uf.union(1, 3)
assert uf.connected(0, 2) is True
assert uf.connected(0, 4) is False
